name: NexaCloud Order Sync — Enterprise CRM Integration Pipeline

nodes.name: 🔗 Webhook: Receive New Order
nodes.notes: Entry point. Receives new signed contract payloads from the sales portal or external partner systems via HTTP POST. Expected payload: { company_name, contact_email, country_iso, phone_e164, plan_tier, annual_contract_usd, signup_date, status }

nodes.name: 🔍 Validate: Required Fields & Business Rules
nodes.notes: Validates: (1) contact_email is non-empty and matches RFC-5322 pattern, (2) company_name non-empty, (3) annual_contract_usd > 0, (4) country_iso non-empty. TRUE branch = valid; FALSE branch = error/circuit-breaker.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Format: Build CRM API Payload
nodes.notes: Transforms validated webhook body into the target CRM API schema. Maps: company_name→account.name, country_iso→billing_country, phone_e164→phone, annual_contract_usd→opportunity.amount. Adds migration batch tag for post-migration SQL reconciliation.

nodes.name: 🚀 Push: POST to Cloud CRM API
nodes.notes: Sends formatted payload to the production CRM REST API endpoint. Uses Bearer token from environment variable (never hardcoded). Timeout: 15s. Includes idempotency via X-Request-ID = execution ID.

nodes.name: 📣 Notify: Slack Success Alert
nodes.notes: Posts a success notification to #data-ops Slack channel with account name, plan tier, ARR, country, and newly created CRM record ID. Enables real-time ops visibility without manual dashboard checking.

nodes.name: 🚨 Circuit Breaker: Capture & Log Error
nodes.notes: Activated when validation fails (FALSE branch of IF node). Identifies which field(s) failed, constructs a structured error record with HTTP 422 simulation, execution ID, and escalation policy. Writes to error log and triggers alert email.

nodes.name: 📧 Alert: Send Error Email to Ops Lead
nodes.notes: Sends a rich HTML alert email to the ops lead with: HTTP 422 status badge, all validation error details in a structured table, the raw source payload (for debugging), and escalation policy (P2: 15-minute SLA). Prevents manual CRM data corruption.
